items.title: Any way to change world size on MC Bedrock Edition?
items.text:
Any way to change world size on MC Bedrock Edition?
Me and my friends are planning to do a sort of anarchy/survival world on bedrock edition via realms. For this to work with only 10 people max, the world can't be too big, around 8k X 8k blocks at most. There seems to be no way to change world size within the mobile app except for infinite and old (old being 256 X 256 blocks). This seems like a strange ommision from the game. Does anyone know a way?
